\label{lemma-relative-bottom-part-degenerates}
In Situation \ref{situation-relative-duality} the pushforward
$f_*\mathcal{O}_X$ is a finite \'etale $\mathcal{O}_S$-algebra
and locally on $S$ we have $Rf_*\mathcal{O}_X = f_*\mathcal{O}_X \oplus P$
in $D(\mathcal{O}_S)$ with $P$ perfect of tor amplitude in $[1, \infty)$.
The map $\text{d} : f_*\mathcal{O}_X \to f_*\Omega_{X/S}$ is zero.

final_content.statement:
Let $S$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme and let $f:X\to S$ be a proper, smooth morphism all of whose fibres are nonempty and equidimensional of the same dimension $n\geq0$.
Then $f_*\mathcal O_X$ is a finite étale $\mathcal O_S$-algebra. Zariski-locally on $S$ there exists a perfect complex $P$ of Tor amplitude contained in $[1,\infty)$ with
$$Rf_*\mathcal O_X\simeq f_*\mathcal O_X\oplus P\quad\text{in }D(\mathcal O_S).$$
Moreover, the map of sheaves induced by the relative universal derivation
$$d:f_*\mathcal O_X\longrightarrow f_*\Omega^1_{X/S}$$
is the zero map.
hypotheses: $S$ is qcqs, and $f$ is proper smooth with nonempty equidimensional fibres of fixed dimension $n$.
conclusions: The zeroth direct image of the structure sheaf is finite étale, the derived direct image splits locally after positive-degree terms, and the differential vanishes on global functions along fibres.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-relative-duality-hodge}
In Situation \ref{situation-relative-duality} there exists an
$\mathcal{O}_S$-module map
$$
t : Rf_*\Omega^n_{X/S}[n] \longrightarrow \mathcal{O}_S
$$
unique up to precomposing by multiplication by a unit of
$H^0(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ with the following property: for all $p$ the pairing
$$
Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S}
\otimes_{\mathcal{O}_S}^\mathbf{L}
Rf_*\Omega^{n - p}_{X/S}[n]
\longrightarrow
\mathcal{O}_S
$$
given by the relative cup product composed with $t$
is a perfect pairing of perfect complexes on $S$.

final_content.statement:
Let $S$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme and let $f:X\to S$ be a proper, smooth morphism all of whose fibres are nonempty and equidimensional of the same dimension $n\geq0$.
There exists a trace morphism in $D(\mathcal O_S)$
$$t:Rf_*\Omega^n_{X/S}[n]\longrightarrow\mathcal O_S,$$
unique up to precomposition with multiplication by a unit of $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$. For every $p$ with $0\leq p\leq n$, composing the relative cup product with $t$ gives a perfect pairing of perfect complexes on $S$:
$$Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S}\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}^{\mathbf L}Rf_*\Omega^{n-p}_{X/S}[n]\longrightarrow\mathcal O_S.$$
hypotheses: $S$ is qcqs, and $f$ is proper smooth with nonempty equidimensional fibres of dimension $n$.
conclusions: A trace morphism exists, unique up to a global unit, and induces perfect relative Hodge pairings.

The proposal correctly reconstructs the inherited situation and uniqueness group; it does not claim a uniquely normalized canonical trace.
